This 6-week program is designed for sport climbers that are new to structured training and would like to build a foundation of power endurance to prepare for pumpy sport climbs. The template is designed to be split across two training days per week.  

The first training can be completed at a boulder wall and should consist of the Warm Up, followed by either 6 in 6 (weeks 1 & 2), Style Triad (Weeks 3 & 6), or Broken Quarters (Weeks 4 & 5).  

The second training day will consist of the Route Warm Up Protocol followed by Route Pyramids (except for week 3).  

Additional sessions can be added to this plan to maintain base endurance or strength & power.
